kv14.1:1.3: Yā akusalassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā --pe-- paṇidhi, sā vā kusalassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā --pe-- paṇidhīti?
kv14.1:2.2: "Yā akusalassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā --pe-- paṇidhi, sā va kusalassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā --pe-- paṇidhīti"?
kv14.1:2.8: Hañci kusalaṃ āvaṭṭantassa uppajjati --pe-- paṇidahantassa uppajjati, no vata re vattabbe
kv14.1:3.9: Hañci kusalaṃ yoniso manasikaroto uppajjati, no vata re vattabbe "Akasalamūlaṃ paṭisandahati kusalamūlan ti." 3.
kv14.1:4.3: Kāmasaññāya anantarā nekkhammasaññā uppajjati, byāpādasaññāya anantarā abyāpādasaññā uppajjati, vihiṃsāsaññāya anantarā avihiṃsāsaññā uppajjati, byāpādassa anantarā mettā uppajjati, vihiṃsāya anantarā karuṇā uppajjati, aratiyā anantarā muditā uppajjati, paṭighassa anantarā upekkhā uppajjatīti?
kv14.1:5.3: "Yā kusalassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā --pe-- paṇidhi, sā va akusalassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā --pe-- paṇidhīti?
kv14.1:6.2: "Yā kusalassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā --pe-- paṇidhi, sā va akusalassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā --pe-- paṇidhīti"?
kv14.1:6.8: Hañci akusalaṃ āvaṭṭantassa uppajjati --pe-- paṇidahantassa uppajjati, no vata re vattabbe
kv14.1:7.9: Hañci akusalaṃ ayoniso manasikaroto uppajjati, no ca vata re vattabbe
kv14.1:8.3: Nekkhamasaññāya anantarā kāmasaññā uppajjati, abyāpādasaññāya anantarā byāpādasaññā uppajjati, avihiṃsāsaññāya anantarā vihiṃsāsaññā uppajjati, mettāya anantarā byāpādo uppajjati, karuṇāya anantarā vihiṃsā uppajjati, muditāya anantarā arati uppajjati, upekhāya anantarā paṭighaṃ uppajjatīti?
kv14.1:9.2: "Akusalamūlaṃ paṭisandahati kusalamūlaṃ, kusalamūlaṃ paṭisandahati akusalamūlan ti"?
kv14.1:9.4: Nanu yasmiñ ñeva vatthusmiṃ rajjati tasmiñ ñeva vatthusmiṃ virajjati, yasmiñ ñeva vatthusmiṃ virajjati tasmiñ ñeva vatthusmiṃ rajjatīti?
kv14.1:9.6: Hañci yasmiñ ñeva vatthusmiṃ rajjati tasmiñ ñeva vatthusmiṃ virajjati, yasmiñ ñeva vatthusmiṃ virajjati tasmiñ ñeva vatthusmiṃ rajjati, tena vata re vattabbe
kv14.1:9.7: "Akusalamūlaṃ paṭisandahati kusalamūlaṃ, kusalamūlaṃ paṭisandahati akusalamūlan ti."
